acceptance: Before any bounded absence, stale, mismatch or unblocked result, one explicit BEGIN snapshot completes all independent request-identity probes across hwa_claims, hwa_controls, hwa_capabilities and hwa_evidence.
The claim scope_key and claim_id probes are independent: a missing requested scope cannot short-circuit the claim_id same-byte-BLOB probe, and a missing claim_id cannot short-circuit the scope probe.

Every requested strict-ASCII identity is searched in canonical TEXT and same-byte BLOB form. Any requested-identity BLOB candidate is fresh commit_authority_corrupt before row selection or absence semantics. Multiple canonical TEXT rows are permitted for non-unique dimension columns and are not ambiguity by themselves.
Every selected claim, control, capability and evidence column has a fixed projection, non-colliding typeof alias, exact SQLite storage class and exact Python type validated before semantic use.
A genuine canonical-row absence retains the existing bounded result only after every applicable requested-identity alias probe is negative in the same snapshot.
No persisted-value coercion, truthiness or SQLite affinity may establish authority; canonical decode and typed reconstruction occur only after complete raw validation.
Fresh bounded errors have cause and context None, raw SQLite/JSON/path data never escapes, ordinary Exception normalizes, and KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit propagate.
The exact public signature, schema, durable tables, indexes, triggers, typed snapshot, statuses, compatibility and default-off behavior remain unchanged.

The twelve exact tests run tests-first, then the full state and dependency corridors, static checks, all three central validators, independent hostile QA and final Deep-Sol on one frozen two-blob candidate.
Only src/headless_write_agent_state.py and tests/test_headless_write_agent_state.py may change under a later separately registered claim; this packet grants no writer or live authority.

implementation_contract.control_identity: Derive the exact owner, repo and run control_key strings with the existing canonical _control_key algebra and probe each key independently in TEXT and same-byte BLOB form before selecting controls or deciding unblocked. Multiple canonical rows sharing owner_id, repo_id or agent_run_id are legitimate; those dimension probes reject BLOB aliases but do not impose uniqueness.
implementation_contract.identity_probe: Each probe is independently keyed only by the one strict requested identity. Canonical TEXT equality and typeof(identity)=blob plus identity=CAST(? AS BLOB) are discovery alternatives; CAST output is never authority. Canonical multiplicity is an error only for schema-unique identity keys, never for non-unique dimension columns.
implementation_contract.no_false_absence: No branch may emit missing, stale_fence, owner_mismatch, released, expired, reclaimed or unblocked because a different requested-identity probe has not yet run.
implementation_contract.public_boundary: Preserve load_commit_authority signature and existing bounded codes. Persisted corruption maps to one fresh commit_authority_corrupt after leaving the caught exception context.
implementation_contract.selected_row_contract: All consumed columns use enumerated fixed projections and non-colliding typeof aliases; exact SQLite class and exact Python type precede comparison, decode, construction or return.
implementation_contract.unrelated_rows: Unrelated foreign rows are not globally audited. Only rows carrying one of the exact requested identities in canonical TEXT or same-byte BLOB form enter the census.

semantic_contract.absence: Only after every requested-identity BLOB probe is negative may a genuinely absent canonical TEXT row become the pre-existing bounded missing, stale or mismatch code.
semantic_contract.absence_order: Before any not-found, stale-fence, owner-mismatch, released, expired or control-absence result, complete an independent request-identity census for every strict caller identity across every table that consumes it.
semantic_contract.candidate_scope: The census searches only for rows carrying a requested identity in canonical TEXT or same-byte BLOB form. It does not reject unrelated foreign rows.
semantic_contract.claim_census: Probe hwa_claims.scope_key and hwa_claims.claim_id independently; neither probe may be narrowed by the other identity, fence, state, owner or scope fields. Any same-byte BLOB candidate is commit_authority_corrupt before claim-row selection.
semantic_contract.compatibility: Preserve the public signature, schema, tables, indexes, triggers, typed snapshot, statuses, claim/control semantics and default-off runtime behavior.
semantic_contract.control_census: Derive the exact owner, repo and run control_key values with the existing canonical control-key algebra and probe each key independently in canonical TEXT and same-byte BLOB form before control selection or unblocked semantics. Non-unique owner_id, repo_id and agent_run_id probes reject BLOB aliases but permit multiple canonical TEXT rows.
semantic_contract.dependent_census: Probe capability_id and evidence_ref independently before missing semantics. Probe every request-relevant control dimension and all three derived control keys before unblocked semantics.
semantic_contract.errors: Persisted corruption yields a fresh code-only HeadlessWriteAgentStateError(commit_authority_corrupt) from None with cause and context None; ordinary Exception normalizes; KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit propagate unchanged.
semantic_contract.no_coercion: No int, str, bool, bytes, truthiness, CAST result or affinity coercion establishes persisted authority. CAST to BLOB is discovery-only.
semantic_contract.row_validation: After the census, fixed projections with non-colliding typeof aliases validate exact SQLite storage classes and exact Python types for every selected claim, control, capability and evidence field before decode, conversion, comparison, truthiness or construction.
semantic_contract.snapshot: One explicit BEGIN read transaction spans the entire identity census, row selection, raw validation, canonical decode, typed reconstruction, binding checks and detached return.

semantic_digest_algorithm: sha256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON for semantic_contract using sorted keys, compact separators and ensure_ascii=false
stale_invalidation: architecture packet, semantic digest or terminal predecessor evidence drift
Rev286 denominator, authority router, continuation inventory, claim or lease drift before registration
detached baseline commit or either exact baseline blob drift
any future claim path, hotfile, pin, command, node, Evidence, owner, lease or correction mirror drift
third path, schema/API expansion, request-narrowed alias-skipping query, coercion, raw return or external effect becomes required
stop_rule: Stop before registration on any packet, predecessor, Rev286 authority, inventory, claim, lease, baseline, path or pin drift. Stop a future writer on any schema change, third path, public API expansion, raw return, incomplete requested-identity census, alias-skipping query, persisted-value coercion, router edit or external effect. Permit one v4 correction only in the complete-request-identity-census-before-absence class; recurrence releases blocked and requires materially fresh Root/Sol architecture.
threat_model: SQLite permits storage-class corruption and same-byte BLOB identities that canonical TEXT equality can skip. The v3r1 loader returned stale_fence before probing a requested claim_id BLOB when the requested scope was absent. V4 makes all request-relevant identity probes an ordered, independent precondition in one read snapshot, rejects every requested-identity BLOB or ambiguity before absence semantics, then validates fixed raw projections without coercion and returns only detached typed authority.
